title: "Wildfires"
author: "Alexa Titherington"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)

raw <- jsonlite::fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson", simplifyVector = FALSE)
length(raw$features)

first_fire <- raw$features[[1]]
names(first_fire)

first_coordinate_pair <- unlist(first_fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]])
first_coordinate_pair

wildfires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties)

wildfires

fires <- wildfires |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
august_count <- fires |>
  dplyr::filter(
    stringr::str_detect(
      incident,
      stringr::regex("\\bAugust\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)
    )
  ) |>
  nrow()

august_count

fires |>
  dplyr::slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  dplyr::filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    lon = purrr::map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(polygon) mean(purrr::map_dbl(polygon[[1]], \(pair) pair[[1]]))
    ),
    lat = purrr::map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(polygon) mean(purrr::map_dbl(polygon[[1]], \(pair) pair[[2]]))
    )
  )
```

```{r}
top_fires <- big_fires |>
  dplyr::slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    boundary_lon = purrr::map(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(polygon) purrr::map_dbl(polygon[[1]], 1)
    ),
    boundary_lat = purrr::map(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(polygon) purrr::map_dbl(polygon[[1]], 2)
    )
  )

top_fires_sf <- sf::st_sf(
  top_fires,
  geometry = sf::st_sfc(
    purrr::map2(
      top_fires$boundary_lon,
      top_fires$boundary_lat,
      \(lng, lat) sf::st_polygon(list(cbind(lng, lat)))
    ),
    crs = 4326
  )
)

leaflet::leaflet(data = top_fires_sf) |>
  leaflet::addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
  leaflet::addPolygons(
    popup = ~paste(incident, "-", fire_year, "-", round(gis_acres), "acres"),
    color = "#b22222",
    fillOpacity = 0.6,
    weight = 1
  ) |>
  leaflet::fitBounds(
    lng1 = min(unlist(top_fires$boundary_lon)),
    lat1 = min(unlist(top_fires$boundary_lat)),
    lng2 = max(unlist(top_fires$boundary_lon)),
    lat2 = max(unlist(top_fires$boundary_lat))
  )
```
